faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Hyderabad JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) leading to Ph.D. position at IIT Hyderabad is 24 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IIT Hyderabad JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) leading to Ph.D. post in the IIT Hyderabad recruitment drive. This is a great opportunity for eligible candidates to pursue research and a Ph.D. at a prestigious institution.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIT Hyderabad?
faq.answer: The salary for a Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is Rs. 37,000/- per month for the first two years, and for a Senior Research Fellow (SRF) it is Rs. 42,000/- per month in the third year, along with 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential qualifications for the IIT Hyderabad JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M. Tech. in Materials Engineering or related fields, or an M. Sc. in Chemistry/Physics/Materials Science with a valid GATE/CSIR score. A background in CALPHAD or Materials Characterization is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for IIT Hyderabad JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category, including General/OBC and SC/ST candidates, for the IIT Hyderabad Junior Research Fellow (JRF) leading to Ph.D. recruitment. This makes it accessible for all eligible applicants.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the JRF position at IIT Hyderabad?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) leading to Ph.D. position at IIT Hyderabad primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and then called for an interview.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the IIT Hyderabad JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of IIT Hyderabad. The application process involves filling out the online form, uploading necessary documents, and submitting it before the deadline of 24 August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. When is the tentative interview date for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The tentative interview date for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) leading to Ph.D. position at IIT Hyderabad is 31 August 2026. Candidates are advised to keep an eye on the official website for any updates or changes to the schedule.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) leading to Ph.D. position at IIT Hyderabad is Contractual. This offers a structured path for research and doctoral studies within the institute's framework.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for the IIT Hyderabad JRF post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) leading to Ph.D. position is Hyderabad, Telangana. This provides an opportunity to work and study in a vibrant academic environment in a major Indian city.
